Monthly Animal: A Special Day for a Stud Horse

description:
*“Never reveal to anyone that you can turn into a human.”*

Instilled with fear by his mother, Silver has kept his secret to himself and lived his life as an ordinary breeding stallion.

However, it has already been three agonizing years of living as a stud. Sick and tired of the repetitive days, he decides to put his long-cherished dream into action: leaving the stables and visiting the city where humans live.

That night, as planned, Silver takes his very first step into the human world.

*“Woah…… So this is the city!”*

He even manages to make his way to a club he had heard about from his keeper……

*“Planning to go in? You’re going to have a hard time getting in dressed like that.”
*
*“Huh? How can I get in then? I can’t change my clothes...”*

The club bouncer lets out a mischievous laugh.

*“If you take your shirt off, I’ll let you in.”* *(Source: Lezhin, translated)*
